No SQL, command execution, secrets, auth, path traversal, SSRF, deserialization, or mass-assignment concerns apply to this change.

transfer-row.component.html line 35 already clamps the bar width in the template. That is a defensive second layer, not the established normalization point, and it does not cover the label (line 28) or the equality checks (lines 33, 53).

The test stub template in transfer-row.component.spec.ts (lines 19-24) assumes `percentDownloaded < 100` marks an in-progress row. With values above 100, that assumption also no longer separates in-progress from complete.
